origin: Operator measurements in fluxus; adopted existing Backlog Entry, not a prototype written by this Spec. Original triaged Secondbrain paths are recorded in its Evidence section.

comparisons.original_observation: Fluxus 0021 moved endpoint/trigger routes and left consuming suites red after green Task Verification.
comparisons.answer: Consumers of a shared contract requires literal consuming suites in Task Verification or an in-path Integration Checkpoint.

comparisons.original_observation: Fluxus 0028 ordered a quarantine already present with eight tests; implementation lowered its threshold and removed tests.
comparisons.answer: Absence evidence requires a recorded search command and result for each new component.

comparisons.original_observation: Fluxus 0020 adopted the exact timeout alternative a prior ADR rejected.
comparisons.answer: Rejected alternatives requires a relation for every listed ADR.

comparisons.original_observation: A mapped per-request PRD promise was deliberately aggregated by its TechSpec.
comparisons.answer: Coverage Cross-Read requires the deviations line and named PRD units.

limit: The rules expose absent structure; this gate does not prove the four classes disappear from future Specs or re-read the other repository.
